unit.why: A short anecdote: a butcher consults the Seer of Lublin about his animals, and the Seer tells from written descriptions which are kosher and which are treif.

stories.start_quote: פ״א בא הטבח ושאל עצה כדת
stories.end_quote: כי תורה היא ולא בשמים היא
stories.summary_en: A butcher asks the holy rabbi of Lublin whether to slaughter his animals for the festival or sell them for fear of treifot; from written descriptions the rabbi declares each one kosher or treif, except one that will raise a doubtful question he cannot foresee, since the Torah 'is not in heaven'.

quotes: בא הטבח ושאל עצה כדת מה לעשות
tags.why: the butcher who slaughters the animals is the protagonist

tags.why: slaughter and the kashrut of the animals (treifot) is the subject
